name: Spotlight theme, dark mode, from opening the panel to picking an app

media.caption: The Spotlight theme puts the query in a capsule of glass and the results in a separate container below it.
media.alt: A recording of Slick's search panel in the Spotlight theme, dark mode, over a purple gradient wallpaper. The theme draws two pieces of glass. A tall capsule holds the search field and a glowing caret. Below it, apart from it, a rounded container holds the results. The panel opens with Music, Notes, Mail and Calendar suggested, each with its Command-digit shortcut at the right. Typing “c”, “a” and “l” narrows the results, and the field completes “calendar” in grey. With “cal” the container shows Calendar, Calculator, Calculator History, Quit All Applications and Eject All Disks. The selection moves down to Calculator. Command-K opens the action panel inside the results container, which grows to fit it. It lists Open, Show in Finder, Show Package Contents, Copy Name, Copy Bundle Identifier and Copy Path with their shortcuts, then Add to Favorites and Set Alias. Command-K closes it again. Return picks Calculator and the panel closes. The scenario notes the launch instead of opening the app. Recorded from the assembled app running a scripted scenario, with Apple's own apps and their real icons.

stills.caption: Before you type, the Spotlight theme shows a capsule with a glowing caret above four suggestions.
stills.alt: Slick's search panel in the Spotlight theme, dark mode, over a purple gradient wallpaper, before anything is typed. A tall capsule of dark glass holds a glowing caret and the placeholder “Search for apps and commands”. Below it, apart from it, a rounded container lists Music, Notes, Mail and Calendar under Suggested, each with its Command-digit shortcut at the right. Captured from the assembled app running a scripted scenario, with Apple's own apps.

stills.caption: The Spotlight theme in dark mode, with the query in its capsule and the results in their own glass below.
stills.alt: Slick's search panel in the Spotlight theme, dark mode, over a purple gradient wallpaper. A tall capsule of glass holds the query “cal”, completed to “calendar” in grey. Below it, apart from it, a rounded container lists Calendar, Calculator, Calculator History, Quit All Applications and Eject All Disks, with Calculator selected. Apps show their own icons and commands show line glyphs. Command-1 to Command-5 sit at the right of the rows. Captured from the assembled app running a scripted scenario, with Apple's own apps.
